messages:
marc_s: Kicking off the NimbleBank POC — need a quick owners + timeline sync. Can folks call out owners for integration deliverables?

leo_se: Thanks Marc. High-level split: API connector, SSO/OAuth, routing/throughput testing, and acceptance criteria. I can lead the SE side.

aj_eng: I can own the API connector work (auth + retries + example app). ETA: next Wed for alpha. Quick Q: do they want streaming websockets or just REST?

sara_sales: NimbleBank prefers REST for now. They did ask about VPC/private deployment and per-customer model pinning. I'll confirm the VPC requirements in our call tomorrow.

aj_eng: OK REST is easier. Note: model pinning requires the exact model variant id. @michael_prod can you share which variant we should lock for the trial? Also will need a test service account for auth.

michael_prod: Recommend we pin to `rwd-3.5-lowlat` for this POC — cost/latency balance. Variant id: rwd-3.5-lowlat-v2. I'll push a short prompt set for quality checks by Tue.

aj_eng: For folks running local tests, here's the minimal call I'll use: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDWOOD_TEST_TOKEN" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"model":"rwd-3.5-lowlat-v2","input":"Summarize: The customer said..."}'
```

leo_se: Eng SRE — can we reserve Dedicated capacity for a throughput run (target 500 req/min) on Thurs window? @sam_sre

sam_sre: I can reserve a dev-dedicated pool Thu 14:00-18:00 UTC. Need final model id and a rough sequence-length distribution (p50/p95) to size batchers.

aj_eng: I'll provide seq len stats from a sample dataset by Tue EOD. Also: I'll open a PR with connector code + unit tests and request review. ETA: Tue.

leo_se: Draft success criteria so we're aligned: 1) 95% of requests under 200ms (p95 < 200ms) on Dedicated test; 2) SSO/OAuth + auth tokens validated; 3) no sensitive customer PII in logs; 4) sample integration app functioning end-to-end; 5) customer acceptance sign-off after UAT. Anything to add?

sara_sales: Add billing estimate to acceptance list (customer wants projected monthly cost). @claire_fin can you compute once we have token/sec?

claire_fin: Happy to. Send token/sec and expected usage window after Thursday tests and I’ll return a ballpark cost model same day.

marc_s: Owners recap: Aj = API connector, Sara = customer liaison & SSO, Sam = SRE/dev pool, Michael = model variant + prompts, Leo = SE lead, Claire = finance estimate. I'll capture these in the tracker and share. :thumbsup:

aj_eng: Quick technical question — do we want to enable KV-prefix caching for the integration samples? That affects latency and correctness slightly.

michael_prod: For first pass, let's NOT enable KV caching. Simpler and ensures deterministic behavior. If latency slips, we can enable and re-test.

leo_se: I'll also add a canary rollout plan: canary traffic 10% -> 50% -> 100% with auto-fallback to rwd-3.5-base if latency/regressions occur.

deploy-bot: PR 4523 opened by aj_eng: "se/nimblebank/api-connector" — CI queued.

marc_s: Great — next checkpoint: Fri 10:00am PT sync (stand-up + tracker update). I'll post the calendar invite.

aj_eng: Will ping for a code review when PR is green. Thanks everyone.
